text:
elaine_cs: Heads-up: NovaRetail renewal triage. Usage down ~72% week-over-week since Mar 10, procurement frozen seats, new procurement lead S. Kim, competitor LuminaAI offered 6mo credits. Also noticed two 503s from our gateway yesterday. Need rapid triage and preservation plan.
mike_csm: thanks. share trend link and any error snippets and I'll loop in Amanda.
elaine_cs: trend: https://redwood.internal/graphs/nova-retail/usage-7d. Error snippet: POST /v1/infer 503 {"error":"upstream timeout: kv-cache-miss -> sync fallback"}. Procurement asking for credits or extended free POC.
priya_se: infra summary: repeated KV cache misses for long-prefix prompts led to batch scheduler fallback to sync path, overloading CPU on edge pool -> transient 503s. Repro with curl returns 503. I have a safe config patch reducing fallback threshold + warm KV on startup in PR #8123. Can stage to their Dedicated pool for a quick smoke.
jordan_sales: procurement asked for 50k token credit or 6 months free. Sales prefers offering a 2-week Dedicated trial (isolated pool) + 10% pilot discount instead. Need pricing sign-off from Amanda. @mike_csm please escalate.
mike_csm: escalating to Amanda & Legal; will draft a customer email to buy time. Elaine, want me to draft the note?
elaine_cs: please. Short note: acknowledge errors, patching underway, offer dedicated trial while we stabilize, request top-20 prompts to warm cache, ask for credit vs trial decision this week.
priya_se: if they share common prompts we can enable prefix-caching and pre-warm KV; staging ready once sales provides Dedicated pool ID.
jordan_sales: I'll position trial as equivalent to credits and push enterprise SLA benefits vs LuminaAI.
incidents-bot: Created INC-4821: NovaRetail gateway 503 surge. Priority P2. Assigned priya_se.
elaine_cs: action items: 1) Mike escalate pricing/legal 2) Priya stage patch + enable prefix-caching 3) Jordan position trial vs credits 4) Elaine schedule 30-min sync with their ML lead to request prompts. Meeting planned tomorrow 11am PT.
mike_csm: escalations sent to Amanda & Legal; CRM updated with decision placeholder.
priya_se: PR merged to staging branch and CI passed; ready to push when pool ID confirmed.
elaine_cs: thanks all. Next update after staging test. :thumbsup:
